title: Special Topics in Education Policy and Administration; Decolonial Methods in Qualitative Research
department: Education Leadership, Higher Ed and International Ed
description: This course will introduce students to core theories, traditions, and practices associated with decolonial research, and examine how qualitative methodologies (e.g. narrative inquiry, case study, ethnography, participatory research, etc.) may act as decolonial tools by fostering more horizontal research practices.
